Item 7.01. Regulation FD Disclosure.

On June 18, 2024, Pharma Solutions Corp. (the "Company") will host an investor day presentation at its headquarters in Boston, Massachusetts. In connection with that event, the Company is furnishing a copy of its investor day presentation as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.

The investor day presentation includes information regarding the Company's updated revenue guidance for fiscal year 2024, key pipeline milestones, and commercial strategy updates. In particular, the Company is updating its full-year 2024 revenue guidance range to $2.4 billion to $2.6 billion, as compared to its previously disclosed guidance range of $2.1 billion to $2.3 billion, reflecting stronger-than-anticipated commercial performance of PHARMAX-7 in the United States and international markets.

The information in this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section. The information shall not be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933 or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
